english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for people watching a performance, film, or event.
This is the all-purpose noun for a person watching an event, such as a sports match, concert, or fireworks display.
This is the all-purpose choice for someone watching a spectacle or television.
Use this for a particular public understood as the audience for a film, show, or other event.
Use this when “the gallery” means the spectators or public watching an event.

examples.traditional: 今晚場戲好睇，觀眾笑到停唔到。
